class.name: SteamSessionTransport
class.brief_description: The Steam Networking Sockets adapter selected by the native Steam game provider.
class.description: Listen games use a Steam individual account and virtual port. A Steam dedicated game uses the certificate-pinned direct IPv4 [code]steam_server[/code] or hosted relay [code]steam_hosted[/code] endpoint. The hosted endpoint also requires a fresh one-shot coordinator grant from the Game provider.

method.name: route
method.description: Construct a versioned P2P endpoint for a valid individual SteamID64 and virtual port from 0 to 65535. Return null when unavailable or invalid. Dedicated locators are resolved by the Steam game provider instead.

method.name: get_host_endpoint
method.description: Return the typed route for the current authenticated authority when the listener and Steam identity are available.

method.name: get_host_remote_limit
method.description: Return the active authority's remote seat limit, or zero without a live listener.

method.name: get_remote_steam_id
method.description: Return the certified Steam identity for the exact ready physical Godot peer, or zero when it is unavailable. Gameplay admission also validates its Session identity.

method.name: open_server
method.description: Open a listener on the configured Steam virtual port or dedicated gameplay port. The bound peer count is 1 to 64. Listen Steam accepts the wildcard bind. A dedicated adapter accepts its configured IPv4 address or the wildcard selection of its configured interface.

method.name: open_client
method.description: Connect on the configured signed-in Steam pipe. The adapter accepts its versioned Steam P2P, dedicated direct, or coordinator-authorized hosted endpoint and checks the remote identity against the expected certificate.
